Dad: What was everyone doing in the hall?
Eva: Leo was watching the training video.
Dad: Was Jo keeping time?
Eva: No. Jo was writing scores on the poster.
Dad: What about Sam?
Eva: Sam was explaining the rules to a new pupil.
Dad: Was Ruby drawing?
Eva: Yes, Ruby was drawing the court.
Dad: And Alex?
Eva: Alex was collecting the sports kit, not counting laps.
